## Description

Constructs multi-scale persistent Betti curves from sliding asset correlation point clouds, using topological feature vectors to trigger macro asset allocation regime switches prior to structural crises.

## Where it may fit

Global macro regime transitions, systemic credit crunches, sudden cross-asset correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Tail-Risk Funds, Tactical Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation matrices, macro leading indicator time series.

## Caveats

Vietoris-Rips filtration thresholds must be calibrated to prevent memory explosion on large asset dimensions.
